snippet.title: Where Winds Meet | The Imperial Palace Trailer: The Game Awards 2025
snippet.description:
Watch the brand-new Imperial Palace trailer, revealed at The Game Awards 2025.

The Imperial Palace arrives by the end of 2026. Stay tuned!

Embark on your legendary wuxia adventure anytime, anywhere on PC, PS5, and Mobile.

Play on mobile now: https://bit.ly/49ErYfg

Download the latest version for PC and PlayStation: 
https://www.wherewindsmeetgame.com/
